summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K and press release announcing the promotion of Thomas Englese to Chief Commercial Officer, effective immediately. Englese had served as EVP, Commercial Operations since September 2024, overseeing go-to-market strategy and the U.S. launch of TONMYA (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets) for fibromyalgia, plus Zembrace SymTouch and Tosymra for acute migraine. No financial terms are stated. This is a routine internal executive promotion and organizational milestone rather than a forced or abrupt departure, so it does not trigger a special-situation event. No risk-arb angle applies; commercial execution and launch metrics remain the operational watch items.
